sender.bs: Prijatelj, rođak ili poznanik, s lažnog ili preuzetog Viber ili Facebook profila
sender.en: A friend, relative or acquaintance, on a fake or hijacked Viber or Facebook profile

name.bs: Lažni profil poznanika na Viberu: „hitno mi treba novac“
name.en: A friend’s fake Viber profile: “I need money urgently”

how.bs: Prevaranti uzmu slike i ime neke osobe sa društvenih mreža i naprave lažni Viber profil, ili preuzmu njen Facebook nalog. Zatim pišu njenim bliskim ljudima: hitan zdravstveni problem, problem s bankovnim računom, treba uplatiti novac ili kupiti bonove. Izbjegavaju poziv i požuruju vas.
how.en: Scammers take a person’s photos and name from social media and create a fake Viber profile, or hijack their Facebook account. Then they write to that person’s close contacts: an urgent health problem, a problem with a bank account, money needs to be paid or vouchers bought. They avoid calls and hurry you.

text.bs: Poruka „poznanika“ s nepoznatog broja ili profila.
text.en: A message from an “acquaintance” on an unknown number or profile.

text.bs: Hitno: bolnica, blokiran račun, nešto se mora platiti danas.
text.en: Urgent: a hospital, a blocked account, something must be paid today.

text.bs: Traži uplatu na račun ili kodove bonova.
text.en: Asks for a transfer to an account or voucher codes.

text.bs: Ne može se javiti na poziv.

Ćao, pišem ti s drugog broja, stari mi je telefon u servisu. Imam jedan problem, kartica mi je blokirana a moram danas platiti račun. Možeš li mi uplatiti 450 KM, vraćam ti sutra čim mi deblokiraju? Ne mogu sad pričati, poslaću ti broj računa.
text.en: Hi, I’m writing from another number, my old phone is being repaired. I have a problem, my card is blocked and I must pay a bill today. Could you send me 450 KM, I’ll pay you back tomorrow as soon as they unblock it? I can’t talk now, I’ll send you the account number.

bs: Novi broj ili profil i odmah molba za novac.
Izbjegava razgovor telefonom ili video poziv.
Hitnost i iznos koji se traži danas.
Molba za bonove ili uplatu na tuđi račun.
en: A new number or profile and an immediate request for money.
Avoids a phone or video call.
Urgency and an amount needed today.
A request for vouchers or a transfer to someone else’s account.

bs: Ne plaćajte ništa dok osobu ne nazovete na broj koji već imate.
Ograničite ko vidi vaše slike i podatke na društvenim mrežama.
Prijavite policiji, uz broj s kojeg je poruka stigla i podatke o uplati.
en: Pay nothing until you call the person on the number you already have.
Limit who can see your photos and details on social media.
Report it to the police with the number the message came from and any payment details.
